agencyName: Virginia Department of Professional and Occupational Regulation (DPOR), Board for Contractors
authorityRationale: DPOR's own regulatory text (A501-27) governing individual tradesman licensing (Journeyman/Master electrician) — confirms DPOR, not DOLI, is the real issuing authority for individual licenses (the Phase 2D.1 open question, resolved in Phase 2D.2 via this document plus independent corroboration).
reliabilityRationale: Primary regulatory text directly from the issuing board, resolving the one governing-authority contradiction found in Phase 2D.1 research.
